entities.name: Additional update result
entities.description: Provides additional information about the result of a combined attach procedure or a combined tracking area updating procedure. It is a type 1 information element.

entities.name: Additional update result IEI
entities.description: Information Element Identifier for the Additional update result information element, located in bits 8-5 of octet 1.

entities.name: Spare bits 4 and 3
entities.description: Bits 4 and 3 of octet 1 are spare and shall be coded as zero. They were used in earlier versions of the specification.

entities.name: Additional update result value
entities.description: Encoded in bits 2-1 of octet 1. Values: 00 - no additional information, 01 - CS Fallback not preferred, 10 - SMS only, 11 - reserved.

entities.name: Combined attach procedure
entities.description: A procedure during which the Additional update result information element may provide additional result information.

entities.name: Combined tracking area updating procedure
entities.description: A procedure during which the Additional update result information element may provide additional result information.

relations.description: The Additional update result information element contains the IEI field.
The Additional update result information element contains spare bits 4 and 3.
The Additional update result information element contains the value field encoding the result.
The combined attach procedure may include the Additional update result information element to provide additional result information.
The combined tracking area updating procedure may include the Additional update result information element to provide additional result information.
The Additional update result information element is defined in this clause.
